        - paragraph: In simple English
        - heading "Understand Distribution Simulation" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Distribution simulation generates random values from a chosen probability distribution. You can learn Distribution Simulation by trying one small example instead of long theory.
        - paragraph: Choose the model, set valid parameters, generate samples, and compare the simulated shape with theory. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
        - paragraph: "In real life, dice simulation: Many rolls approach the die distribution. Watch out: Thinking one simulation is the exact distribution. A simulation is random evidence; the theoretical distribution is the model."
